sections.title: Intermediate Thai II
sections.description: A continuation of Intermediate Thai I, this class builds on the speaking and writing skills learned in that class. This intermediate level course is designed for students who have completed Intermediate Thai I or possess equivalent proficiency. This course focuses on expanding students’ vocabulary, complex sentence structures, and long-form conversations. Greater emphasis will be placed on reading and writing skills while reinforcing listening and speaking abilities. Thai cultural elements will be incorporated throughout the course. The medium of instruction is both Thai and English.
